units.axis: Unity world space: +x right, +y up, +z away from camera
units.pivot: normalised from sprite bottom-left; (0.5,0) = ground contact

sort.rule: sorting_order ascending, then (y+z) descending (far first), then root_order ascending
sort.sort_point: the sprite pivot, i.e. the ground-contact point
sort.note: depth is y+z, not z. y gives ordinary top-down painter ordering; z is a per-object manual nudge and is 0 for 2234 of the 2329 objects. sorting_order outranks both, which is what keeps the terrain tilemaps under everything and interleaves the shadow tilemaps.
